submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve stylized game animation. Create ONE real independent full-body RUN frame of 07 Moon Shadow Assassin Girl, not a sprite sheet. Input1 confirmed N idle sets exact identity, VIEW DIRECTION, anatomy and costume. Input2 primary approved clean rounded Daoist chibi painterly STYLE only; do not draw UI. Input3 run reference sets rendering polish, body/head scale and motion language; never copy its direction or pose. Direction: NORTH / DIRECT BACK VIEW, exactly facing AWAY from viewer. NO eyes, face or nose visible. Anatomical RIGHT is screen-right, LEFT screen-left. Large three-petal navy/gold moon hair ornament is on anatomical LEFT, screen-left edge of head, exactly like idle. Silver-lilac short bob, single curved ahoge, navy/ivory/gold short robe and scarf, baggy blue trousers, crescent boots, exact original waist ornaments. Preserve original identity and materials, bright clean soft hand-painted highlights. Exactly TWO arms, TWO hands, TWO legs, TWO boots. Exactly TWO crescent daggers total, ONE held firmly in each hand with continuous shoulder-elbow-wrist chain, no floating or spare blades. Keep both daggers visible to each side even when an arm is foreshortened, bend elbows naturally; no arms-wide fixed showcase. Torso leans into run, real opposite arm/leg coordination. Fixed native square1254 if supported, minimum1024 transparent RGBA, root x50% and virtual contact-ground y94%, same global scale as third image without recentering to bbox. Hair near top8%, entire sprite within canvas; keep blades/scarf/tips safely inside. Not attack or parade marching. Exact phase 10 of16: LEFT foot remains planted screen-left and settles flat; left knee bends and pelvis dips1%. RIGHT heel folds closer to buttocks with sole visible screen-right. RIGHT forward-away arm remains HIGH, LEFT rearward arm LOW. Small advance from input3 contact, independently drawn. Genuine articulated drawing, no mirror, copies, interpolation or warp. True transparent empty background, no scene/floor/shadow/text/grid/FX/trails. Target GPT Image2.5 Sunburst/max; actual tool settings host-managed.
